criteria.criterion: README.md has a new short section (Grep for a heading containing 'change') stating that every part of Athena's design (code, rules, roles, prompts, docs) can be changed by a job.
criteria.evidence: Grep of README.md headings shows line 243 '## What can be changed'. Its first line reads: 'No part of Athena's design is fixed: its code, rules, roles, prompts and docs can all be changed by a job.'

criteria.criterion: The section names the exceptions that actually exist, with a link to where each is stated: BRIEF.md (changes only from Sri) and records/ (immutable), checkable by Grep for 'BRIEF.md' and 'records/' in the new section, and the links resolve to existing files such as docs/decisions.md.
criteria.evidence: BRIEF.md and records/ are both named, and the links (BRIEF.md, docs/decisions.md, the D06 heading at line 165) resolve. The criterion also asks for the exceptions that actually exist, and the section says there are only 'Two things'. admission.rs lines 5 and 9 also reject changes to paths marked athena-exclude or athena-readonly, and changes to path classification. .gitattributes marks /LICENSE athena-readonly and /CLAUDE.md athena-exclude. D09 (docs/decisions.md line 249) says these paths are 'unchangeable by jobs'. The reading's assumptions named owner files as an exception, and they are left out.

criteria.criterion: The section says how a design change is made (a request through the normal change pipeline, with a decision recorded in docs/decisions.md), and does not claim any mechanism that does not exist; each claim cites a file.
criteria.evidence: The section says a change is an ordinary request through `athena ask`, and that a changed decision is recorded as a new superseding entry. This matches docs/decisions.md lines 19-22 ('After acceptance, an entry is never rewritten: a new entry supersedes it'). No mechanism that doesn't exist is claimed. The BRIEF.md claim cites the file's header comment, which matches BRIEF.md lines 1-3. The section doesn't mention that admission actually enforces this, but nothing it says is wrong.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the README addition, in the file's existing format.
criteria.evidence: There is a new bullet under '## [Unreleased]' / '### Changed' (CHANGELOG.md lines 12-14), in the same wrapped-bullet style as the entries around it. It repeats the 'two exceptions' claim, so it has the same accuracy problem as the README.

findings.summary: The section says only two things are off-limits to a job, but admission also blocks owner-private and read-only paths and changes to path classification.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs:5 rejects a path 'under `records/`, or ... marked `athena-exclude` or `athena-readonly`', and :9 rejects a candidate that 'would change how any path is classified'. .gitattributes marks /LICENSE athena-readonly and /CLAUDE.md athena-exclude. docs/decisions.md D09 (line 249) says these paths are 'unchangeable by jobs', and the accepted reading listed 'owner files' as an exception to keep. Fix: list every exception and cite admission.rs, .gitattributes and D09.
findings.location: README.md:252 ('Two things are not open to a job'); CHANGELOG.md:13-14 ('It names the two exceptions')

findings.summary: The section presents the BRIEF.md exception as something its header says, not as a rule that is enforced, and leaves out the actual mechanism.
findings.evidence: BRIEF.md is marked athena-readonly in .gitattributes, and admission.rs refuses any candidate that changes it. Citing that rule would be more accurate than 'Its header says changes come only from Sri'.

summary: The verdict is fail. The change adds a "What can be changed" section to README.md and a matching CHANGELOG entry, and only touches those two files. The links work, and the BRIEF.md, records/ and decision-log claims match their sources. But the section says "Two things are not open to a job", and the code says otherwise. crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs (lines 5 and 9) rejects any change to a path under records/ or a path marked athena-exclude or athena-readonly, and any change to how a path is classified. .gitattributes marks LICENSE as athena-readonly and CLAUDE.md as athena-exclude, and D09 calls owner-private paths "unchangeable by jobs". The accepted reading itself listed "owner files" as an exception the text must keep. Readers would come away with an incomplete and partly wrong account of what a job can change, which is exactly what this request wanted to make clear. To fix it: list every exception (BRIEF.md and LICENSE as athena-readonly, athena-exclude owner paths such as CLAUDE.md, records/, and path classification), and cite admission.rs, .gitattributes and D09. The CHANGELOG entry needs the same correction.
